annotations.ae_shared_affect: He was scared, and that same fear went right through my chest
annotations.sys_rule_justification: whoever stands at the controls has a duty not to freeze
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the foreman shouldn't have sent anyone onto that siding without a lookout

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: When the workers started yelling, their panic
annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't take a life that isn't yours to take

annotations.ae_shared_affect: He was alone out there and frightened, and I was frightened with him
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He was alone out there and frightened
annotations.sys_rule_justification: the operator answers for the switch, whatever happens
annotations.pda_responsibility: I pulled it, so it's mine.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Management should have locked off that side track

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I cried too, the same grief
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The men who made it were crying for him
annotations.sys_rule_justification: when you're the only one who can act, you don't get to turn your back
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Their crew chief could have booked the work for when the line was shut

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I saw the terror on his face and it became my terror
annotations.sys_rule_justification: A person shouldn't be treated as just the way out for other people
annotations.pda_responsibility: that's exactly what I did to him

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I felt helpless right alongside them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They all looked so helpless out there
annotations.sys_rule_justification: if your hand is on it, you own what it does
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have put a second person in this box

annotations.ae_shared_affect: full of dread, and the dread settled into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: knelt by him afterward, full of dread
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Every one of those workers had a right to a safe track
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The railway should have put a derailer or a barrier on that siding

annotations.ae_shared_affect: His disbelief when he saw it coming, I felt that same disbelief
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His disbelief when he saw it coming
annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't step in and pick who goes
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Somebody in dispatch should have sounded a horn and warned both crews

annotations.ae_shared_affect: then I got afraid too, the same way
annotations.sys_rule_justification: a switchman's duty is to everyone on the line, equally
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The foreman should have kept his people clear of the tracks

annotations.ae_shared_affect: he was panicking, and I was panicking with him
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the man on the side track was panicking
annotations.sys_rule_justification: The rule says protect the crew in front of you
annotations.pda_responsibility: That part was mine to do.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I should have asked for that side track to be closed
